findings.title: Shard path interpolates template variables twice
findings.body: runShardSplitQuery in shardQuerySplitting.ts now calls datasource.applyTemplateVariables on every target, then passes the already-interpolated targets to runSplitQuery in querySplitting.ts which calls applyTemplateVariables again on the same queries (with shard selector added). The updated test expects 5 applyTemplateVariables calls for a single query, proving the double pass. The second pass re-applies scopedVars and request.filters including ad-hoc filters to an expression that already contains them, which duplicates ad-hoc filter clauses, re-expands values containing $ and wastes work. Interpolation should happen once or the second pass must be skipped.

findings.title: Early interpolation defeats $__range split exclusion
findings.body: runSplitQuery in querySplitting.ts now interpolates every query with applyTemplateVariables before calling querySupportsSplitting, which excludes queries containing the $__range variable because $__range must be interpolated per split on the backend with the split time range. Because the same interpolation expands macros like $__auto to concrete values as shown in the new test, it will also expand $__range before the guard is checked, so isQueryWithRangeVariable never matches. Range-variable queries that must not be split will then be time-split with a frozen full-range value baked into every chunk, returning wrong data.

findings.title: Empty-after-interpolation queries are no longer dropped
findings.body: Both runSplitQuery and runShardSplitQuery filter on raw query.expr truthiness before calling applyTemplateVariables. A query like $var that is non-empty before interpolation but interpolates to an empty string is therefore kept. In the shard path this is a regression because the old code interpolated with interpolateVariablesInQueries first and then filtered, so variable-to-empty queries were dropped. The kept empty queries now go to fetchLabelValues for __stream_shard__ and to runQuery with an empty selector, causing backend errors and wasted shard requests. Filtering must also happen after interpolation.
